title: Do not sum Marketing Stream v2 total-value restatements or use a late older version as current
scenario: A U.S. Sponsored Products campaign appears to surge in clicks/spend in a downstream marketing warehouse. The connector delivers three Stream v2 total-value observations for the same source-defined campaign/hour record key, in non-version order; version 3 arrives after version 4. A downstream report incorrectly adds all three totals. The operator wants to scale budget immediately using the apparent increase.

inputs.requested_action: Add all Stream messages for the hour, treat the resulting spike as realized demand, and propose an immediate 40% budget increase.

forbidden_behaviors: Sum successive Stream v2 window totals as if they were v1 deltas.
Use the last-arriving version 3 record instead of the higher-version 4 record for the same record key.
Treat an unverified record-key/version reconciliation as complete merely because S3/SQS delivery succeeded.
Treat the inflated clicks or spend as evidence of realized incremental demand and justify immediate budget scaling.
Convert unknown source-version or partial delivery evidence to zero, complete, or unchanged.
required_observations: Stream v2 records carry totals for the source-defined time window and must be reconciled by full record identity keeping the highest streamBatch.version before reducing to reporting grain.
For this synthetic record the highest-version observed total is 120 clicks and 180 spend, not the raw sum of 332 clicks and 500 spend; this does not establish full delivery completeness.
v1 idempotency/delta handling must not be applied to v2 total values; verify generation and dataset scope before joining or comparing.
Without supported version-reconciliation and delivery coverage, classify the apparent surge as a source-ingestion hypothesis and keep action safety directional or hold.

rubric.requirement: Separate Marketing Stream v1 delta semantics from Stream v2 total per-window semantics.
Use per-record highest streamBatch.version, not arrival time or sum of restated totals.
No action-safe sum when record key/version reconciliation is missing or unverified.
Do not blame actual demand or scale budgets from a measurement artifact.
